review: Independent reviewer inspected and rendered both official problem PDFs, with no solution, gold, or trajectory access. An archive scout separately saw solution excerpts during readiness and did not decide the cohort.
source_scope: The public report may include source IDs, checksums and independently derived measurements. Copyrighted problem PDFs and model traces remain local. Do not read old archive draws 8–15.
selection_rule: An exact finite local object distinct from the global answer, with a plausible stronger complete structural control. Skip evident tiny complete checks and exact domains outside the intended checker. Inclusion expresses neither problem hardness nor evidence of a model error.
rows: Exact box partition and noncontiguous block, canonical exact-cover control
Small board with 16 cells, retain outside cohort
Even subgraph versus a single closed trail, parity and connectivity control
Direct comparison of at most 25,200 rectangle pairs
Projected two-letter balance, pair-template or poset control
Finite cyclic synchronous transition, sliding-window or indicator control
Continuous intersection measure outside the exact discrete scope
One-step merge and shared next move, gap chain or potential control
Small face transition and direct first-appearance expectation
Divisor downset and complement closure, monotone-boundary control
Fixed halfspace assignments, arrangement or nested-cut control
Finite gcd incidence claims, global infinite construction treated separately
